## How I Can Help — Core Services

### 1. Production AI & Agentic Systems
- **Problem Solved**: Prototypes work in demos, but making them reliable, testable, and cost-effective in production is difficult.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: LangGraph StateGraph coordination where specialized agents (Citation Intelligence, Technical Auditor, Remediation) run with isolated state contexts and retry limits.
  - **RAG & Evaluation**: Hybrid dense + sparse retrieval, verifiable citations, Recall@5 / MRR regression checks, and Pydantic schema validation.
  - **Multi-Model Failover & Cost Controls**: Fallback routing (OpenAI GPT-4o to Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock) with exponential backoff, jitter, and token budget governance.
  - **Observability & Tracing**: End-to-end token auditing, latency tracing, and OpenTelemetry/LangSmith instrumentation.

### 2. Backend & Distributed Systems
- **Problem Solved**: Scaling platforms need to handle growth, concurrency, integrations, and partial failures without becoming fragile.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Concurrency Safety**: Redis Distributed Locks (Redlock) paired with ACID transaction boundaries and row-level locking to mitigate race conditions during burst traffic.
  - **Idempotent Pipelines & Ledgers**: HMAC webhook validation, Bloom/cache deduplication, AWS SQS/Celery asynchronous queues, and double-entry transaction ledgers with Stripe Connect reconciliation.
  - **Database & Cache Engineering**: PostgreSQL indexing, PgBouncer connection pooling, read-replica routing, and hierarchical Redis cache invalidation.

### 3. Enterprise Architecture & Integrations
- **Problem Solved**: Existing legacy systems, directories, and business processes must integrate cleanly without introducing operational risk.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Workflow Automation & Modernization**: Replacing manual paper/departmental handoffs with deterministic routing engines and enterprise content repositories.
  - **Security & Governance**: Role-based access mapped to corporate Active Directory / LDAP groups with immutable audit trails.

## Detailed Case Studies & Production Proof

### Case Study 1: Wellows — Multi-Agent LLM Search Visibility Platform
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/wellows/
- **Role**: Solutions Architect
- **Challenge**: Single-query prototype scripts degraded under concurrent load, with unguarded token spend and ungrounded model outputs across AI search surfaces.
- **Architecture**:
  - Partitioned workflow into three specialized agents: **Citation Intelligence**, **OPTA**, and **KIVA** under a LangGraph supervisor.
  - Shared Qdrant retrieval layer grounding both analysis and remediation content against the same brand corpus.
  - AWS SQS FIFO and dead-letter queues (DLQ) decoupling ingress requests from long-running jobs so failed tasks remain preserved for inspection and retry.
  - AWS Bedrock failover to Claude 3.5 Sonnet on OpenAI HTTP 429 rate-limits.

### Case Study 2: Savyour — High-Throughput Cashback & Affiliate Fintech
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/savyour/
- **Role**: Solutions Architect / Engineering Lead
- **Challenge**: Retail promotion bursts triggered concurrent affiliate webhooks across 100+ merchant integrations, risking race conditions and duplicate ledger credits.
- **Architecture**:
  - HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification with in-memory Bloom deduplication and sliding Redis idempotency windows.
  - Redis Redlock mutexes backed by ACID PostgreSQL double-entry ledger accounting and row-level locking on hot accounts.
  - Hierarchical Redis caching with probabilistic early expiration to protect primary database reads.

### Case Study 3: ClassFlow — Live Tutoring Marketplace SaaS
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/classflow/
- **Role**: Lead Architect
- **Challenge**: Manual cross-timezone scheduling bottlenecks and checkout surges caused booking race conditions across instructor time slots.
- **Architecture**:
  - Deterministic timezone and load-scoring matchmaking state machine in FastAPI.
  - 45-second Redis Redlock checkout reservation holds paired with ACID PostgreSQL transactions to prevent concurrent booking collisions.
  - Automated Stripe Connect idempotent transfer orchestration and WebSocket session presence tracking via Redis Pub/Sub.

### Case Study 4: Enterprise Insurer — Enterprise Document Workflow Architecture
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/efu-life/
- **Role**: Enterprise Architect
- **Challenge**: Paper-bound insurance underwriting records and manual department handoffs created multi-day review queues and audit tracing gaps.
- **Architecture**:
  - Branch document capture and OCR classification queue extracting policy identifiers.
  - Centralized high-availability enterprise content repository with structured metadata search.
  - Rules-based approval dispatch across 5 core underwriting chains integrated with corporate Active Directory / LDAP permissions.

### Case Study 5: Production RAG — Measurable Retrieval Architecture Reference
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/production-rag/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/uzairkhatri/production-rag-reference
- **Role**: Architect & Author
- **Architecture**:
  - FastAPI service with decoupled retriever, embedder, reranker, and generator boundaries.
  - Hybrid BM25 + dense vector retrieval with explicit reranking, grounded citations, Recall@5/MRR evaluation, and CI quality regression gates.
